title: Is this a leek?
description: It seems like this resource pack replaces the fancy cardboard sword from the Create mod with a leek that makes you feel like that blue-haired person!
body:
![Preview the resource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3785feda761687e6eaa514f026f1db546e95838_0.webp)

So, while playing with the Create mod, I found it pretty funny to replace the cardboard sword with a leek, referencing Hatsune Miku and her love of leeks. This resource pack simply replaces the cardboard sword model with a leek, nothing more. Have fun!
